description: Update document-level settings: fps, frame range, current frame, active camera, active take. FPS and frame range are also mirrored onto the active render data.

active_camera.description: Name of the camera object to set as scene camera.

active_take.description: Name of the take to make current (Main is always valid).

fps.description: Document FPS (also mirrored to active render data).

frame_end.description: Document max time / loop-max in frames.

frame_start.description: Document min time / loop-min in frames.

name: set_document
title: Set Document Settings
